assumptions: 2-digit year rule 00-50 -> 20xx, 51-99 -> 19xx is intentional and correct.
Context rows with empty statement_period_end are intentionally kept (not rejected) with context_reason.
Column-to-period mapping by index when header has multiple dates is acceptable; order follows _extract_explicit_date_labels output order.

critical.issue: No tests for 2-digit year boundaries (00, 50, 51, 99), 4-digit year, invalid month/day; missing tests for column mapping (2 dates in header -> 2 columns get correct period).
critical.fix_example: Add test_extract_explicit_date_labels_2digit_year_boundaries (00->2000, 50->2050, 51->1951, 99->1999), test_extract_explicit_date_labels_four_digit_year, test_extract_explicit_date_labels_invalid_month_skipped, test_extract_explicit_date_labels_invalid_day_skipped; add test that _resolve_table_period_for_column with table_header_text 'AS AT 30-JUN-25 AS AT 30-JUN-24' and col_idx 0/1 returns '30 June 2025' and '30 June 2024' respectively.

warnings.issue: When header has mixed formats (e.g. AS AT 30-JUN-25 and 31 December 2024), output list order follows finditer order (DATE_PERIOD_RE then as_at_dd_mon_re), which may not match visual left-to-right; column mapping can assign wrong period to column.
warnings.fix_example: Document behaviour or consider building header_dates in left-to-right order (e.g. by match start position) when mixing patterns.

warnings.issue: Column period uses extract_period_labels (and infer_header_date_from_mixed_text) which do not use _extract_explicit_date_labels; DD-MON-YY-only column header yields empty column period.
warnings.fix_example: Optionally run _extract_explicit_date_labels on per-column near_text in infer_column_metadata and use first match for period when extract_period_labels returns nothing.

warnings.location: _date_for_col when ncols=2 and duplicate date in header (2681-2693)
warnings.issue: Duplicate date in header deduped to one label; _date_for_col returns '' for both columns; both columns fall back to base_period/context.
warnings.fix_example: Document that duplicate dates in header result in no column-level date from header_dates; or allow duplicate labels when building header_dates for mapping (by position) if needed.

suggestions.issue: Blocks with multiple subsidiary names (Peak View, Deep Dykes) and multiple AS AT dates have no entity-to-period association; mapping is by column order only.
suggestions.fix_example: Document that period-entity association in multi-entity blocks is positional; consider a data-quality flag when block contains multiple entity-like names and multiple dates.

suggestions.issue: Downstream assumes statement_period_end when present; empty can create one bucket for all empty-period rows.
suggestions.fix_example: Document that statement_period_end may be empty for context rows; callers that key on (file, statement_period_end) should treat empty explicitly or filter.
